'''Command Base''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Roche asteroid field]] controlled by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] used the asteroid as his command base while heading the [[Shantipole Project]].

==Description==
===General description===
The Command Base was an hourglass-shaped [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. The asteroid's outer crust was covered in air vents and [[repulsor beam projector]]s that were highlighted by points of light. The interior of the asteroid was carved into the rock, with corridors and ceilings having no uniform height or width. Control panels and other machinery was built into the walls, and the entire facility was a cross between a high-tech community and a cave. Subdued track lighting was used throughout the base.<ref name="SFS" />

===Command and control systems===
The base's command center was the heart of the Command Base. [[Computer/Legends|Computer]] displays lined the walls of the command center, monitoring the [[Roche system]] and the [[Roche asteroid field]]. Personnel working on the base also coordinated the activity of the other asteroid colonies involved in the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] project. While the design and construction of the B-wing was handled by [[Research Station Shantipole]], other asteroids were required to handle supplies and communications. One side of the room was dominated by a [[holo-tank]], and the base's [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] could be controlled from the command center's main console.<ref name="SFS" />

Just outside the command center, a separate room housed the base's communications center. The room was filled with control consoles and chairs lining the walls. Near the middle of the room was a large, clear [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] board that had the trajectories of larger asteroids within the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] traced on it.<ref name="SFS" />

An auxiliary command center, including computers and communications equipment, was located just off the [[lifeboat bay]]. The center was intended for use during an emergency.<ref name="SFS" />

===Crew facilities===
The living quarters on the Command Base consisted of one main room organized into a large communal barracks, an arrangement that the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpines]] preferred. Along one wall, five separate small rooms were set up for use by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and his Alliance team. A recreation area was also on the base, housing tables and chairs, a [[food dispenser]], and a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] game.<ref name="SFS" />

One part of the base was dedicated to storage filled with boxes of supplies for both the Verpine and the Alliance personnel. Most items needed by the personnel of the base could be found in the storage area, except for weapons. A [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] was also present on the asteroid, equipped with eight beds, asingle [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], and a curtained-off surgical area.<ref name="SFS" />

===Hangar facilities===
The main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay was carved from the asteroid, hewn out of reddish-brown [[Stone/Legends|stone]]. The bay had a high ceiling, but narrow walls, barely fitting a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] and a pair of [[asteroid hopper]]s. A control tower was mounted on one wall, jutting out over the hangar deck. Instrument panels and cooling equipment covered the walls.<ref name="SFS" />

Two exits led away from the hangar bay. The main exit was a wide stone passage accessed a corridor leading towards the communications center, living quarters, and main [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. The second exit led straight to the base's recreation area.<ref name="SFS" />

A lifeboat bay was located at the other end of the asteroid, which handled smaller craft and most of the asteroid hopper traffic. The bay included three medium sized [[lifeboat]]s recessed into the outer wall and ready for immediate launch. Each lifeboat was capable of carrying fifteen passengers each.<ref name="SFS" />

===Life support systems===
Power to the Command Base was provided by five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall main [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] located in a rocky room near the hangar bay. Catwalks, accessible by ladders, ringed the upper levels of the generators and pipes led from the machinery into the stone walls to transfer power to the base. Back-up power was provided by an auxiliary power unit located in a room near the main generators, where it was housed alongside an auxiliary [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] system.<ref name="SFS" />

Life support systems for the Command Base included [[atmosphere generator]]s mounted on [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-thick bases of reinforced [[Permacite/Legends|permacite]]. Dozens of pipes led out of the machines into the rocky walls, generating an air supply for the entire base. The hollowed-out room had three [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]] to the asteroid's exterior, and a wall locker containing ten [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]].<ref name="SFS" />

The Command Base also had three tall silver [[repulsor beam generator]]s interconnected by a number of thin filaments/ Each generator produced the power necessary to shield the asteroid from collisions with other asteroids in the field.<ref name="SFS" />

==Inhabitants==
The Command Base was staffed by fifty Verpine and a half-dozen members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Alliance contingent was led by Commander Ackbar, assisted by his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] [[Salin Glek]] and [[Netrem Pollard/Legends|Netrem Pollard]]. The Verpine [[Suskafoo]] served a mediator between the Verpine population and the Alliance personnel.<ref name="SFS" />
